deviceId.label: BACnet device ID of the panel

clientId.label: BACnet client device ID (as configured in the panel)

bind.label: Local IP to use (optional)
bind.help: Only needed if the ioBroker server has several network cards

pollInterval.label: Poll interval (s)
pollInterval.help: Changes usually arrive at once via COV; polling is the safety net and keeps the panel's client supervision happy

foreignDevice.label: Register as foreign device at the panel (BBMD)
foreignDevice.help: Needed when ioBroker and the panel are in different subnets/VLANs; requires 'BBMD freigeben' in the panel

ctrlWarn.text: Commands change the state of a fire alarm system (reset, silence, disable detectors, switch outputs). Only enable this if you are allowed to operate the system and know the consequences.
